name: I Transferred to an All-Girls School and Everyone Won't Stop Talking About Me!
original_name: Joshikō ni tenkō shitara, min’na ga boku no hanashi de mochikiri datta!
overview: A teenage boy transfers to an all-girls school and quickly becomes the centre of attention, but what starts as an awkward new life soon turns into a complicated mix of friendships, rivalry, and unexpected emotions as secrets and misunderstandings begin to surface.
